trunk.description: Normalized 3D direction vector of the trunk segment, pointing from the midpoint of the hips toward the midpoint of the shoulders.

left_upper_arm.description: Normalized 3D direction vector of the left upper arm, pointing from the left shoulder toward the left elbow.

right_shin.description: Normalized 3D direction vector of the right shin, pointing from the right knee toward the right ankle.

overall_visibility.description: Geometric mean of MediaPipe landmark visibility scores across body landmarks.

left_knee.description: Angle between the left thigh and left shin, measured at the left knee. Smaller values indicate greater knee flexion.

right_knee.description: Angle between the right thigh and right shin, measured at the right knee. Smaller values indicate greater knee flexion.

left_hip.description: Angle between the trunk and the left thigh, measured at the left hip joint. Smaller values indicate greater hip flexion.

right_hip.description: Angle between the trunk and the right thigh, measured at the right hip joint. Smaller values indicate greater hip flexion.

left_ankle.description: Angle between the left shin and the left foot, measured at the left ankle joint. Reflects ankle dorsiflexion or plantarflexion.

right_ankle.description: Angle between the right shin and the right foot, measured at the right ankle joint. Reflects ankle dorsiflexion or plantarflexion.

left_wrist.description: Angle between the left forearm and the left hand, measured at the left wrist joint.

right_wrist.description: Angle between the right forearm and the right hand, measured at the right wrist joint.
